metric: Triangle area of heads (R1ps, R/2, R1ak); plotted field = log10(1/max(area,ε)). Larger = closer to colinear. Yellow is high 1/area, not exact 1.
layout: row-major T (slow) × sigma (fast): index = jT * nSigma + iSigma
notePrevYellow: Earlier plots used window-normalized distance so most cells were ~1 (almost as good as the best cell), not exactly colinear.
caveat: R1ak = Kuznetsov/i1 estimate, not exact Siegel f(s); T clamped to ≥1e-4
